integrity.claim_scope: Exact equilibrium-balance check for the stated model and R3 data.
integrity.evidence_basis: Full-text equations, equilibrium formulas, numerical parameter sets, and figure captions were compared with exact-rational substitutions.

scientific_limitations: The result diagnoses the printed equations and printed numerical parameter/equilibrium tuples. It does not exclude another positive equilibrium or a Hopf bifurcation after the equilibrium and linearization are corrected.
title: Two equilibrium balance identities invalidate the reported R3 Hopf base point
